verdict.rationale: Slack documents a public Web API for querying and changing workspace state, with 200+ methods, per-method references such as chat.postMessage, and Block Kit payloads. It also documents an Events API (Socket Mode or HTTP), official SDKs and Bolt frameworks, an official OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec repo, and a dated deprecation changelog. The probe found no OpenAPI file on the docs domain, but the spec is published on GitHub, so this does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API (no probe actually exercised an API call).
